title: Teasel Exchange
description: Two interrupted songs are introduced separately, then fitted together so that one hand fills the other’s silence. Their uneven groups of seven eighths shift emphasis from phrase to phrase. First the upper notes lengthen across the lower entries, then the lower notes do the same. A later exchange of registers restores the original gaps; the two closing gestures release at different times.
technical_note: Treat the opening rests as part of each melody. In the first combined passage the hands alternate cleanly without pedal. Later overlapping versions retain the pitch order while extending selected durations. Prepare the left hand’s treble-clef phrase and return without accenting the register change.

performance.note: Authored phrase breathing and melodic voicing; independent rhythm is written in the score, with a shared tempo map.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
